lines.text: Jesus says He came to fulfill the Law, and righteousness must exceed that of the scribes and Pharisees.
Jesus says anyone angry with his brother is subject to judgment, and anyone who says 'You fool!' to hell's fire.
Jesus says to leave your gift and reconcile first, or the judge may hand you to the king.
Jesus says to turn the other cheek, and if someone sues for your tunic, let him have your sandals too.
